answer_verbatim:
If you want the **best online courses for shadow work**, the strongest options in your results are the **Jung Platform’s “Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work,”** **Awake Academy’s “Embracing The Shadow” with Charlie Morley,** and **Shadow Work’s “Basic Facilitator Training Online”** for a more formal training path.[3][10][7]

For a broader mix of **shadow work and spiritual practice**, the most relevant courses in your results are:

- **Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work** — a more psychologically grounded option centered on Jungian concepts.[3]
- **Embracing The Shadow** — a spiritual/meditative approach led by Charlie Morley.[10]
- **Shadow Work: Embrace Your Full Self For Healing And Growth** on Insight Timer — positioned as healing and self-integration oriented.[11]
- **Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self** on Udemy — a practical self-study course with a mainstream platform format.[2]
- **Shadow Mastery Course & Exercises** — a structured online course focused on shadow work exercises.[4]
- **Shadow Work Practitioner Online Certificate Course** — a certificate-based option if you want something more formal.[5]

A useful way to choose is by **style**:

| If you want… | Better fit |
|---|---|
| **Psychology/Jungian framing** | Jung Platform course[3] |
| **Spiritual or contemplative practice** | Awake Academy / Charlie Morley[10] |
| **Structured self-guided exercises** | Centre of Excellence or Udemy options[4][2] |
| **Certificate/credential** | Courses for Success[5] |
| **Facilitator-style training** | Shadow Work basic facilitator training[7] |

The “best” course depends on whether you want **personal healing**, **spiritual development**, or **professional-style training**. If you want the safest starting point, pick a course that is explicitly **structured**, **step-by-step**, and focused on **integration** rather than just journaling prompts.[8][3][4]
